chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Ismail al-Ju'fi, from Abi Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

The Sharia (Law-code) of Nuh (peace be upon him) was that Allah be worshipped by Tawhid (divine unity) and Ikhlas (sincerity) and to shun the idols - and it is the Fitra (innate disposition) which He created the people upon …
ai.seo_question: What was the core message of Prophet Nuh's Sharia and how does it relate to human nature?
ai.summary: Imam Abi Ja'far (peace be upon him) identifies the core Shari'ah of Prophet Nuh (peace be upon him) as Tawhid and Ikhlas, linking it directly to the primordial Fitra inscribed in human nature. This narration underscores the Shia view that the message of all prophets is fundamentally consistent, rooted in the innate recognition of God's oneness rather than disparate legal codes. It highlights the continuity between prophetic revelation and the natural disposition of humanity.

en.ammaar-muslim: 4. [4/-] al-Kafi: Ali b. Ibrahim from his father from Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Abi Nasr from Aban b. Uthman from Ismail al-Ju’fi from Abi Ja’far عليه السلام who said:
